description: Constructed teaching calculations, not experimental data or a proposed molecular formula.
coordinate: x is the dimensionless numerical m/z coordinate; use n = |z| and report polarity separately.
constant_assumptions: Proton mass rounded from NIST CODATA 2022 value 1.0072764665789 u.
Other ionic masses calculated from NIST neutral-atom isotope masses with one electron subtracted for cations or added for the chloride anion.
Electron mass used to derive constants: 0.0005485799090441 u, NIST CODATA 2022.
Electronic and molecular binding-energy mass corrections are neglected.
Nine retained decimal places are calculation constants, not claims of nine-decimal physical exactness or instrument accuracy.
Natural isotope selection uses the most abundant isotope of each listed element; no isotope labeling is modeled.
Examples assume the monoisotopic assignment is correct and the assigned ion exists; they do not predict relative abundance or occurrence of all ion forms.
